To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the reprocessing of the raw data by DENZO and re-refinement by CNS resulted in a significant improvement in the quality of the refined structure of garlic lectin.

(a) data processing using DENZO and refinement using CNS can improve the resolution, the definition of the model and the map quality; (b) the quality of the map and model can also be improved by refining the structure using the data processed by DENSO and XDS, but the improvement is not as significant as in the case of DENZO and CNS; (c) refinement of the structure using data processed by XDS and refined by X-PLOR does not improve the resolution, map

(i) reprocessing of the data using DENZO resulted in a substantial improvement in the quality of the map and hence the quality of the refined structure, (ii) refinement with CNS afforded a better definition of the structure than X-PLOR, and (iii) reprocessing of data and refinement with CNS together provided the best results.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the use of re-refinement using re-processed data to improve a structure.
the use of reprocessed data and the use of different packages for the refinement of a structure.
the application of re-refinement to a case in which the initial refinement was carried out using data processed by XDS.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
reprocessing and re-refinement with CNS is an effective way to improve the quality and resolution of a structure, especially when it is difficult to grow better crystals.
the re-refinement of the structure of garlic lectin using reprocessed data and a different refinement program has improved its quality substantially.
the structure of dimer garlic lectin has been determined to a resolution of approximately 2.2 A using reprocessed data and refined with CNS.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the structure was improved to a resolution of better than 2.2 A by reprocessing the data and re-refining the structure with CNS.
the use of the latest refinement package and data-processing package in combination can improve the quality of a structure, especially if the data are from a weakly diffracing crystal.
reprocessing of the data using DENZO and re-refinement using CNS improved the quality of the model, and the definition of structural features.
The main takeaway from our work is that
re-refinement using re-processed data may be an alternative to growing better crystals.
reprocessing of the raw data using DENZO and re-refining with CNS improved the quality of the final map and of the refined model.
re-processing of the data and re-refinement of the structure can often be a viable strategy when the quality of the crystals is poor and the resolution of structure determination is not satisfactory.
